title: Mirror-image bleed-through of A-3A Gunnery Scope Presentation chart
description: Reverse side of the B-52 aircraft number 394 radar scope chart page, showing the A-3A Gunnery Scope Presentation printed backward as show-through from the facing side. The mirrored grid, range marks (1,000 to 8,000), the "Blip of unidentified aircraft" and second-B-52 blip annotations, and the AF Form 112 header and SECRET markings are all visible in reverse. The handwritten circled "1" and number appear reversed at lower left.
